h: רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ תַּמּוּז, ב׳ Rosh Chodesh Tammuz, 2

p: [פְּרִי עֵץ חַיִּים, שַׁעַר רֹאשׁ חוֹדֶשׁ ג]
חָשַׁב שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר צֵירוּפֵי שְׁמוֹת הוי״ה
listed twelve permutations of the Name Havayah
for the twelve months of the year.
And the permutation of this month is HVHY,
וְזֶה מוֹרֶה עַל מִדַּת הַגְּבוּרָה וְדִין,
and this indicates the attribute of Gevurah and judgment,
as stated in the holy Zohar
"rows in reverse, in the secret of Gevurah."
And so it is written in the holy Zohar
"and therefore the order of the letters is in reverse."
וְכֵן בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קפו, א):
And likewise in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 186a):
is in the order of the letters, Aviv," etc.,
but the seventh month, which is Mine,
is from the end of the letters, tav-shin-reish."
The point is that in the month of Tishrei
"Today is the birth of the world";
meaning, as it arose in thought
to create the world with the attribute of judgment,
while Nissan is as it was created in actuality,
after He joined the attribute of mercy
(רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כז, א, דִּבּוּר הַמַּתְחִיל כְּמַאן)
that "these and those are the words of the living G-d":
in Tishrei it arose in thought to create,
and it was not created until Nissan.
And Rosh Hashanah is called in the Tikkunim
and the attribute of Gevurah is called fire,
And it may be that this month,
when the sun is at its height,
was created with this attribute, the attribute of Gevurah;
and so wrote the early authorities,
that it is called Tammuz on this account —
after the fire and the heat,
from the language of the pasuk (Daniel 3:19),
In the kelipah it is the trait of jealousy,
and in holiness it is the trait of yiras Shamayim.
And this is what is said in Sefer Yetzirah:
"He crowned the letter ches in sight," etc.,
For re'iyah, sight, has the letters of yirah, awe;
that is, when a person takes to heart
the Holy One, blessed be He,
stands over him and sees his deeds,
And this is the trait of Yitzchak,
fear upon those who are near;
שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עוֹמֵד עָלָיו מַמָּשׁ.
that the Holy One, blessed be He, literally stands over him.
וְעַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרָכוֹת כח, ב):
This is along the lines of what Chazal said (Berachos 28b):
"May the fear of Heaven be upon you
like the fear of flesh and blood," etc.,
when a person commits a sin,
he says, 'May no person see me.'"
מִכְּלָל שֶׁמּוֹרָא שָׁמַיִם הוּא גַּם כֵּן
This implies that fear of Heaven also means
that he should see that the King of kings
And his trait is the attribute of Gevurah,
the aspect of fire, as mentioned above.
And this fire burns up the evil fire,
"And the house of Yaakov shall be fire
and the house of Yosef a flame," etc.,
"and there shall be no survivor of the house of Esav."
"and the coming day shall set them ablaze," etc.,
"and for you who fear My Name there shall shine
a sun of righteousness, with healing in its wings."
And it states in the Gemara (Nedarim 8b):
as it says, 'And there shall shine,' etc.,
and the wicked are judged by it," etc.
And this is what is written (Yeshayah 66:23):
"And it shall be, from one new month to the next," etc.,
to bow down before Me," etc.;
and right after it is written (ibid. 24):
"And they shall go out and look
upon the corpses of the men," etc.
Now why is the looking at the wicked necessary?
אַךְ כֵּיוָן דִּכְתִיב יָבֹא כָל בָּשָׂר,
But since it is written "all flesh shall come,"
meaning when they are in a body,
when there is still a yetzer hara;
and even though then the evil
will be nullified from the yetzer hara,
nevertheless it will not be nullified entirely,
only that it will not be repulsive,
like one who bathes and immerses from his impurity;
that is, desire will be only for the good,
as stated in the holy Zohar
that the yetzer hara may return and overpower,
for the serpent came upon Adam HaRishon
to entice him even in Gan Eden,
even though it was a holy body,
since he was in Gan Eden with the body.
"And they shall go out and look," etc.;
וְעַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר [יְשַׁעְיָה יט, כב]
along the lines of what it says (Yeshayah 19:22),
smiting for Mitzrayim and healing for Yisrael,
כְּעֵין שֶׁנִּדְרָשׁ (בַּזּוֹהַר חֵלֶק ב לו, א);
similar to what is expounded (in the Zohar II 36a);
that is, through the plagues upon Mitzrayim
fear and awe fell upon Yisrael,
וְכֵן כָּאן כְּתִיב וְיָצְאוּ וְרָאוּ וְגוֹמֵר,
And so here it is written, "And they shall go out and look," etc.,
וְעַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר [צְפַנְיָה ג, ו–ז]:
along the lines of what it says (Tzefanyah 3:6–7):
"I cut off nations; their towers are desolate," etc.,
"I said: Surely you will fear Me,
And this is what it says, "The righteous are healed by it" —
"And not only that, but they delight in it,
as it says, 'And you shall go out,' etc."
"they delight in it" — that is, the Supernal Eden;
and it comes about because, when awe enters
"If your sins be like these years
from the six days of Creation,
they shall become white as snow" —
that they will be like merits;
for "there is no light except that
which emerges from within darkness." Thus far.)
And this is why it says, "He crowned the letter ches."
For we find that the letters ches and tes
were not in the names of the tribes
only the letter tes was written
in "Shivtei Yeshurun" on the Urim VeTumim,
and the letter ches in Yitzchak,
דְּאוֹת ח׳ מוֹרֶה עַל מִדַּת הַגְּבוּרָה,
For the letter ches indicates the attribute of Gevurah,
and that is awe, and the sight
in which one sees that the King of kings,
the Holy One, blessed be He, stands over him;
and this is the trait of Yitzchak,
the Holy One, blessed be He, before their eyes."
And this is as we said,
a letter is first mentioned in the Torah,
there lies the root of the letter,
about the letter tes, that it indicates good,
since the pasuk opened with it
And the first letter ches in the Torah
is in the word vechoshech in the first utterance;
is the Hidden Intellect, concealed from all thought:
and from this branch out the deeds of the wicked,
"and their deeds are in the dark"
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 184a):
and there is no good except that
וְהַיְינוּ דְּאוֹר הוּא אוֹר כִּי טוֹב,
That is, light is "the light, that it was good,"
and the opposite of light is darkness,
and the opposite of good is evil.
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁכֵּן הָיָה בְּרִיָּיתוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם:
That is, for such was the creation of the world:
that is, so that it should be "very good" —
light that emerges from within darkness.
Tishrei has its letters in reverse,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם אָמְרוּ (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה יח, א):
between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur";
is included in the ten days,

it states in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 148b):
for the kuf resembles in its form the letter hei.
And the letter ches is for the reason mentioned:
that it indicates the deeds of the wicked.
And the two letters ches and kuf
are found in the name of Yitzchak Avinu,
and from him came forth the dross, Esav,
who is the kelipah of the attribute of Gevurah,
the permutation of this month, HVHY,
which is Gevurah, as mentioned above,
is alluded to with Haman, in the final letters of
וְכָל זֶה אֵינֶנּוּ שֹׁוֶה לִי [אֶסְתֵּר ה, יג],
"Yet all this is worth nothing to me" (Esther 5:13),
for he is of the kelipah of Amalek,
and "Amalek is the first of the nations";
that is, it is the aspect of darkness
and this kelipah wishes to swallow up everything,

that there be light emerging from within darkness;
which were given on Yom Kippur,
the abundance of wisdom to rectify the abundance of anger.
And this is the task of this month:
"He crowned the letter ches in sight" —
for through sight, which is awe,
they will rectify the ches of choshech.
And this is as it says (Yeshayah 30:20),
"And your eyes shall see your Teacher";
and we said that it means
for the service of Hashem Yisbarach,
for the entire world and the creatures in it
were created with the letters of the Torah,
"I was the instrument of the craft
of the Holy One, blessed be He";
and this is what it says (Yeshayah 40:26),
which is the Name of the attribute of Gevurah,
is made of the letters mi eleh
And this is the trait of Yitzchak,
